newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bank arranges credit for power expansion.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bank arranges credit for power expansion.

text.p: The China Construction Bank has promised to arrange for credit of 10 billion yuan ($1.2 billion) over the next five years for the electric power industry in east China, the China Daily Business Weekly reported on Sunday.

The newspaper said the financing was agreed last week between the bank and three major power companies in the east China area -- East China Electric Power Group Corp, Shanghai Electric Power Co and Shenergy Co Ltd.

The three companies agreed to maintain their main accounts with the Construction Bank, and to use the bank as their main source of financing, and in return the bank agreed to give the three companies lending priority, it said.
The 10 billion yuan will be used for renovation and capacity expansion, the newspaper added.
